name: Non-exponential transport kernel via macroscopic optical depth
definition: A method to model non-exponential attenuation in heterogeneous media by decomposing the medium into explicitly modeled density variations and statistically modeled density fluctuations, using a base transport kernel dependent on macroscopic optical depth.
summary: This method renders heterogeneous media by decomposing the medium into a 3D density field and a 1D base kernel, allowing arbitrary spatial density while assuming statistically homogeneous correlations.
